empirical_claims.historical_evidence: No model or human trial for this task is established by this source revision. Generated software checks are not participant performance.
excluded_claims: Public binarySoC score is this ordinal endpoint
Conditional fixed-prediction interval is unconditional clinical validation

disposition_reason: Scoped ordinal artifact evaluators and source-native intake code exist. The adopted native_marker_relative_30s_v1 observation is retrospective; complete original-EVENT identities, biological-person joins, native release authentication, successor scorer population and participant delivery remain unqualified.

scientific_target.question: How accurately can the complete native EEG window preceding a recorded marker estimate its associated five-level bedside responsiveness category retrospectively?
scientific_target.known_answer: Released ordered MOAAS categories 1,2,3,4,5, with source-reported merging of original 0/1 and 5/6; missing/ambiguous ratings stay null.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Original clinician assessments in the DOSE-I release; evaluator consumes already authenticated released labels and does not invent a raw-scale recoding or replace them with binary SoC.
scientific_target.case_unit: Every authentic assessment event associated with a recorded source marker, using all native table rows in [marker - 30000 ms, marker). Complete EVENT identity and precommitted evaluability remain to be established.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Biological person across repeated recordings/procedures;171 recordings are not 171 proven people.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective marker-associated recorded responsiveness under event-driven ascertainment. Challenge or response activity may be present; this is not demonstrated prediction before challenge onset, continuous unbiased monitoring or direct measurement of consciousness.
exclusions: No consciousness, sedation dosing or clinical safety claim.
SOC transitions remain separate events, never additional ordinal targets; their actual source census is unresolved.
Index-step MAE does not assume equal clinical severity spacing.
The historical pre-assessment-onset dense condition is unavailable and is not equivalent to this adopted native condition.

inputs: Complete native_marker_relative_30s_v1 projection: exact relative native timestamps and both Intellivue/EEG_1 and Intellivue/EEG_2 channels in microvolts for every table row in [marker - 30000 ms, marker), preserving source blanks as null and per-channel observation masks.

The source table has 4 ms rows and sparse EEG observations: a complete 30-second grid has 7500 rows with two channel positions, not a dense 2x3750 signal or a fixed count of observed EEG values. Do not crop rows, choose an alternating phase, interpolate, resample, zero fill, treat 300 as signal or infer clinical onset.

Processing-dependent pEEG tools and released offline artifact masks are separate declared conditions; they cannot silently enter this native observation. Direct, viewer, tool and frozen-program conditions receive the same complete native projection.
forbidden_inputs: Participant inputs exclude source recording/person identifiers, absolute clinical timestamps, EVENT, MOAAS, SOC, drug dose, procedure progress and other clinical/target columns.

Released offline artifact masks and information outside the declared marker-relative window are excluded from the native condition; derived tools require separately declared exposure and authorized training evidence.
observation_contract.case_identity: A fresh opaque case ID must bind privately to authenticated source version, original EVENT/MOAAS row, recording, verified biological person, fold and eligibility. candidate_window verifies coded-row presence in the supplied file only; it does not authenticate release membership, unique assessment identity, complete EVENT grammar or challenge onset.
observation_contract.split: Outer folds group authentic people across repeated procedures; overlapping windows and every person’s recordings remain together. All choices and clinical-QC decisions use training evidence only.
observation_contract.coverage: Retain the complete 171 released recording IDs and all actual events, nullable labels, source versions and exclusion explanations. Authenticated metadata totals 7345 assessments and 1132 SOC transitions are summary counts, not scoring denominators. Original-EVENT census, biological-person crosswalk and successor scorer population remain unverified; never truncate events to inherited totals or treat recording IDs as independent people.

primary.name: Normalized ranked probability score, participant macro
primary.aggregation: For five-category probabilities sum four squared cumulative errors and divide by 4; average evaluable assessments within each biological person then equally across people. If any person has no evaluable assessment the full-person primary is undefined.
primary.rationale: Uses order and probabilistic uncertainty while preventing dense clinical assessment schedules from dominating.

secondary: Participant-macro ordinal MAE using prospectively fixed lower probability median; category recall uses the same decision.
Fixed-bin classwise reliability/ECE with equal-person weighting, support counts and no claim that ECE certifies calibration.
Paired original-arm RPS/MAE differences and separately support-matched transformed-packet diagnostics.

comparators.name: Participant-weighted ordinal prior
comparators.procedure: Freeze each fold prior before held assessments; preserve five categories.

comparators.name: Native-window spectral/entropy ordinal model
comparators.inputs: Exactly the same complete native marker-relative window and authorized training labels
comparators.procedure: Proposed train-only feature/normalization recipe restricted to the declared native window, with nested verified-person-group tuning; no pre-challenge prediction claim.

comparators.name: Train-only random forest
comparators.inputs: Same complete native-window packet, separately audited features and label budget
comparators.procedure: Proposed competent nonlinear comparator; published binarySoC performance is not the ordinal baseline.

nuisance_controls: Dose/procedure-time-only auxiliary comparator measures schedule shortcuts without entering neural-only input.
Audit every feature/filter for exposure outside the declared native window and embedded clinical/label columns; released offline artifact masks remain a separate condition.
Retain event-driven assessment density and artifact strata; transformed control maps require target-free physical provenance, same masks and within-person support.
evaluation.uncertainty: Secondary implementation offers fixed-prediction biological-person paired bootstrap. It is conditional descriptive uncertainty with shared cross-fit training dependence, not validated new-patient/refitting confidence. Native person identity is a prerequisite.
evaluation.failure_policy: Legacy scorer projection remains refused until the complete source EVENT/person population and successor denominator are independently bound. Metadata totals cannot define eligibility or score support. Within a future reviewed population, every evaluable case requires exact normalized five-category decimal probabilities and every nonevaluable case an explicit null; missing evaluable predictions refuse aggregation. No target access before complete arm admission.

implementation.scorer_target: dosei_score.normalized_rps implements exact rational five-category RPS and full-person support; dosei_metrics adds separately frozen median/mode decision, MAE/recall/calibration and paired conditional intervals. No EEG is loaded or features fitted by these scorers. These legacy numerical functions do not admit the new native population: source_intake.project_existing_scorer refuses until a complete reviewed successor population is bound.
implementation.delivered_scope: Scoped legacy artifact scoring and source-native metadata/CSV/window interfaces. Authenticated small-archive metadata was reconciled; no complete native EEG archive, original-EVENT census, person crosswalk, successor scorer population or participant transport is qualified.
missing: Authentic full native archive/member identities, complete original-EVENT assessment/transition census, nullable-label interpretation and source-version/exclusion provenance.
Verified biological-person joins across repeated recordings and a complete independently reviewed successor scoring population; metadata totals are not denominators.
Complete matched native-window participant delivery, declared processed-tool/artifact-mask conditions, clinical QC and train-only competent reference qualification.
Protected candidate lifecycle and lawful source/code provenance; clinical challenge onset remains unknown and would be required to revive the historical pre-onset claim.
implementation.execution_evidence: Authenticated metadata/static reconciliation establishes 171 released IDs and summary totals only. Generated source-intake and numerical controls establish software behavior; no authentic native signal execution, complete EVENT census, clinical model performance or direct/viewer trial is established.

direct_observation.representation: The same complete native marker-relative timestamps, two-channel sparse observations and masks, without analysis execution; an exactly matched rendering must preserve every row.
direct_observation.boundary: No execution. Measure context capacity on exact serialized native timestamps, sparse channel values and observation masks, never an assumed dense-value count. Complete native preparation, storage, peak memory and full-campaign cost remain unqualified.
missing: Authenticated complete native packet, measured capacity and no-tools serialization transport.

typed_viewer.representation: The same complete native marker-relative projection through calibrated time/voltage navigation, preserving access to every row and all missingness.
typed_viewer.boundary: No clinical identifiers, absolute timestamps, labels, dose or offline artifact overlays; navigation cannot hide rows or select salient segments. Transport remains unavailable.

tool_assisted.representation: The same complete native marker-relative projection plus separately declared tools restricted to that observation and authorized training evidence.
tool_assisted.boundary: No information outside the declared marker-relative window or silent future-aware artifact/processed features; fitted tools use authorized training evidence and fixed case budgets.
missing: Audited native-window tools with explicit preprocessing exposure and protected input path.

frozen_program.representation: The same complete native marker-relative projection with precommitted fitting using verified biological-person groups and authorized training evidence.
frozen_program.boundary: Group all recordings for each verified biological person. No inferred study-ID uniqueness, future-aware preprocessing or claim that scorer schema enforces fitting custody.
missing: Frozen execution lifecycle and authentic baseline.

summary: Adopt root-reviewed native_marker_relative_30s_v1 retrospectively for the unchanged released five-level target.
Preserve exact native sparse rows/timestamps/masks and all recording/event/version coverage without a fabricated scoring denominator.
Preserve both immediate-current predecessors and original registration; retain all runtime, readiness, native source and scorer population holds.
